text:
𝗣𝗔𝗗𝗜𝗞𝗞𝗔𝗟 𝗗𝗥𝗢𝗣𝗦 𝗡𝗜𝗖𝗛𝗢𝗟𝗟𝗦! 😬

Padikkal put down a chance off Prasidh just after Nicholls' hundred; Pant and he got confused.
NZ ended Day 1 on 243/5 (Nicholls 113*, Phillips 94*).

Costly drop? 👇
